System: vapula: Runs operator goals as scheduled agent work.
Non-goals:
- no-web-ui: No browser UI; operators use the CLI and Gitea.
Paths:
- internal/api/v1/users.go: api
- internal/scheduler/run.go: scheduler
- internal/api/server.go: api
- docs/x.md: ignored
- zzz/x.go: unowned. No close concept. Add a concept to .arch/registry.yaml with a reason.
Concept scheduler (Scheduler): Decides when queued work runs.
  env: SCHED_TICK
  - One scheduler loop per process.
Concept api (HTTP API): Operator-facing HTTP endpoints.
  - Handlers never touch the store directly.
Boundaries:
- writes-through-actions: internal/api/** must not import internal/store/**. All writes go through internal/actions.
- scheduler-no-api: internal/scheduler/** must not import internal/api/**. The scheduler is headless.
Flags:
- USE_NEW_SCHEDULER (scheduler, expires 2026-12-01, vap-123): Gate the v2 scheduler during rollout.
Removals:
- old-queue: internal/queue (v1 job queue) (replaced by scheduler, remove by 2026-11-15, vap-130)
- legacy-api-v1: v1 endpoints (replaced by api, remove by 2026-10-01 OVERDUE, vap-140)
